witness.note: Iudicium Dei III: Liebermann’s edited Latin text, from the manuscripts he names in Gesetze I, p. 401, note b, listed below
Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France, MS 943
Pierre Pithou, glossary to the Capitularies (1588), printed
London, British Library, Cotton MS Vitellius A.vii (Vt, the first pontifical)
Cambridge, Corpus Christi College, MS 422, formerly The Rede boke of Derbye
Strood, Medway Archive and Local Studies Centre, MS DRc/R1 (Textus Roffensis; formerly Rochester, Cathedral Library, MS A.3.5)

div.head: Iud Dei III 1.5
div.ab: et cognoscant caeteri, quia nomen tibi Dominus, et tu solus altissimus super omnem terram, et serui tui in te glorientur et laudent nomen tuum in secula seculorum. Amen.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 408 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: and that others may know that Lord is your name, and you alone are most high over all the earth, and that your servants may glory in you and praise your name for ever and ever. Amen.
